title_sq: Tek 5 Maji, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Perfekte !
description_sq: Ne Rrugen 5 Maji tek Residenca Alb-Edil ,shitet apartament 2+1+2 me planimetri dhe orientim perfekt. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto 105.65 m2, neto 94.25 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e 2-te banim te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar (me dritare), nje dhome per femije dhe nje tualet kryesor. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje cka i mundeson ndricim natyral dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Prona eshte e pajisur me dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Until May 5, 2+1+2 apartment with perfect floor plan for sale!
description_en: On Rugen 5 Maji, at Residence Alb-Edil, a 2+1+2 apartment is for sale with a perfect layout and orientation. The apartment has a gross area of ​​105.65 m2, net 94.25 m2 and is located on the 2nd residential floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a double bedroom with a dedicated toilet (with window), a children's room and a main toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The property is equipped with full mortgage documentation.
